interpretation_limits: Training losses are not COD test metrics or causal improvements.
No COD internal validation exists in full4040 run, so neither best test epoch nor overfitting can be inferred.
Teacher and source GT validation use different model-generated cues; their total losses are not a matched teacher/student fidelity score.
KD scalar/GT scalar ratios do not identify gradient contribution; quality weights and easy/background pixels also affect scalar KL.
CUDA peak field measures the primary process current device only, not five-device total or system memory.
